integrity: The proof is analytic. The packaged exact checker only replays matrix decomposition and special-point identities; finite sampling is not used as proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem minimizes negativity only on the complete diagonal probability simplex generated by the three displayed nearest-neighbor vectors in 2 by 4. It does not optimize over coherent density operators in the same support or over higher dimensions.
title: Exact least negativity in the three-generator qubit–ququart NPT simplex
